verdict.rationale: Letta exposes programmatic surfaces, including an App Server with an OpenAI-compatible API and a TypeScript Agent SDK, so a downloadable API spec is a fair question for this product. However, the probe found no OpenAPI or Swagger document at any candidate path (all 404). The llms.txt file it did find is an LLM-oriented docs index, not a machine-readable API specification. No evidence shows a downloadable spec.
